```{r dag-sens-define, include=FALSE}
dag_sens <- dagitty('dag {
bb="0,0,1,1"
Age [pos="0.100,0.100"]
Sex [pos="0.280,0.100"]
U [latent,pos="0.750,0.080"]
TMB_BRAF [pos="0.200,0.380"]
CRP [pos="0.720,0.320"]
T [exposure,pos="0.050,0.680"]
TxTMB [pos="0.350,0.560"]
TxCRP [pos="0.760,0.560"]
TLR [pos="0.560,0.560"]
PFS [outcome,pos="0.720,0.760"]
OS [outcome,pos="0.900,0.920"]

Age -> OS
U -> TMB_BRAF
U -> CRP
U -> PFS
U -> OS
TMB_BRAF -> PFS
TMB_BRAF -> OS
TMB_BRAF -> TLR
TMB_BRAF -> TxTMB
CRP -> PFS
CRP -> OS
CRP -> TLR
CRP -> TxCRP
T -> PFS
T -> OS
T -> TLR
T -> TxTMB
T -> TxCRP
TxTMB -> PFS
TxTMB -> OS
TxCRP -> PFS
TxCRP -> OS
TLR -> PFS
PFS -> OS
}')
```

```{r dag-sens-plot, fig.width=9, fig.height=7}
#| fig-cap: "Sensitivity DAG for the METIMMOX-1 analysis, excluding the Age -> TMB_BRAF and Sex -> TMB_BRAF edges while retaining all other assumed causal relationships. Solid arrows denote assumed causal effects; dashed arrows indicate the hypothesised interaction effects of T x TMB/BRAF and T x CRP on PFS and OS."

tidy_dag_sens <- tidy_dagitty(dag_sens)
tidy_dag_sens$data <- tidy_dag_sens$data |>
  mutate(
    y    = 1 - y,
    yend = if_else(is.na(yend), NA_real_, 1 - yend),
    hyp  = !is.na(to) & name %in% c("TxTMB", "TxCRP") & to %in% c("PFS", "OS")
  )

pal <- c(
  "exposure" = "#2166ac",
  "outcome"  = "#b2182b",
  "latent"   = "#1b7837"
)

plot_dag <- function(tidy_dag_obj, caption_pal) {
  node_data <- node_status(tidy_dag_obj)$data |>
    distinct(name, x, y, status)
  x_range <- range(node_data$x, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_range <- range(node_data$y, na.rm = TRUE)
  x_pad <- diff(x_range) * 0.10
  y_pad <- diff(y_range) * 0.10

  ggplot(tidy_dag_obj$data, aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend)) +
    geom_dag_edges_link(
      data = function(d) dplyr::filter(d, !is.na(to), !hyp)
    ) +
    geom_dag_edges_link(
      data = function(d) dplyr::filter(d, !is.na(to), hyp),
      edge_linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    geom_dag_node(
      data = node_data,
      mapping = aes(x = x, y = y, colour = status, fill = status),
      size = 24, inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_dag_text(
      data = node_data,
      mapping = aes(x = x, y = y, label = name),
      colour = "white", size = 3.0, inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    coord_equal(
      xlim = c(x_range[1] - x_pad, x_range[2] + x_pad),
      ylim = c(y_range[1] - y_pad, y_range[2] + y_pad),
      clip = "off"
    ) +
    theme_dag() +
    scale_color_manual(
      name     = "Node type",
      values   = caption_pal,
      na.value = "grey55",
      breaks   = c("exposure", "latent", "outcome"),
      labels   = c("exposure" = "Exposure (T)",
                   "latent"   = "Latent (U)",
                   "outcome"  = "Outcome (PFS, OS)")
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      name     = "Node type",
      values   = caption_pal,
      na.value = "grey55",
      breaks   = c("exposure", "latent", "outcome"),
      labels   = c("exposure" = "Exposure (T)",
                   "latent"   = "Latent (U)",
                   "outcome"  = "Outcome (PFS, OS)")
    ) +
    theme(
      legend.position   = "bottom",
      legend.text       = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.title      = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      plot.margin       = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
    )
}

p <- plot_dag(tidy_dag_sens, pal)
print(p)
```

```{r save-figure, include=FALSE}
figs_dir <- here("figs")
if (!dir.exists(figs_dir)) dir.create(figs_dir, recursive = TRUE)

ggsave(
  filename = here("figs", "clin_effect_figure_s2.png"),
  plot = p,
  width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 300, bg = "white"
)
cat("Figure saved to:", here("figs", "clin_effect_figure_s2.png"), "\n")
```

Figure saved to `figs/clin_effect_figure_s2.png`.
